mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is <= 0.5%, the S&P 500 has positive 20-day forward returns due to low interest rates compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 has negative 20-day forward returns due to recessionary concerns and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1600 and UNRATE falls below 5.5%, the S&P 500 has positive 20-day forward returns as housing market strength and improving labor conditions signal economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600 and UNRATE < 5.5 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 270), the S&P 500 has negative 20-day forward returns due to rising interest rates and inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 270 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 100, the S&P 500 has negative 20-day forward returns due to declining industrial production signaling an economic slowdown and reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1600 and INDPRO falls below 100, the S&P 500 has positive 20-day forward returns as housing market strength and declining industrial production (indicating a shift to services) signal economic resilience.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1600 and INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 > 19000 and HOUST > 1600), the S&P 500 has positive 60-day forward returns due to sustained economic growth and strong consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 19000 and HOUST > 1600 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in a t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 275, the S&P 500 has negative 5-day forward returns due to heightened inflation expectations and central bank hawkishness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 275 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns in a t-test against zero).
